decisions.reason: The source replaces a blog keyword but does not select, replace, or otherwise change any blog topic.
The source changes the separate blog-keyword selection and does not modify the campaign keyword count or the campaign keyword replacement already recorded.
Replacing a blog keyword does not change the requirement to produce and publish three blog articles during the trial.
The general requirement to include search-volume data remains valid unchanged; the source does not mention search volume or alter its current state.
